title: Samsung s10e May patch caused constant reboots while using xdrip+
body:
Please help ro resolve this problem. I can not use the xdrip+ on my phone. After May 24 - the phone reboots every from 1 to 10 minutes. If I stop the sensor or delete the xdrip - everything begin to work fine.
I use Dexcom G5 sensor. The Samsung s10e OS is of version: G970FXXU1ASE5/G970FOXM1ASE5/G970FXXU1ASE5

comments.body: I have the same problem too. I tried to reset the phone (s10 +) and install the last version of Xdrip but the problem was not solved. what version of xdrip do you have?

I've tried the latest one. Did not help.
Eventually it started to work with disabled option "Use the OB1 Collector".
I think, it is not normal. It would be nice to use the OB1 Collector.
I have the same issue. And on top of that, Xdrip misses readings when I disable the OB1 collector.
I agree, xdrip works worse without OB1 collector.
How can we solve it?

Have you guys tried my settings here?

https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/891
I have the same issue, please help.

> Have you guys tried my settings here?
> 
> #891


I tried to set xdrip with your settings. Let's see if it works. Should you install the latest patch?
@davide1985, I'm running the latest beta.
Hi, this morning I received a new update on the samsung s10 +. Can we activate the "OB1 Collection" again

> Hi, this morning I received a new update on the samsung s10 +. Can we activate the "OB1 Collection" again

Have you checked this?

> > Ciao, stamattina ho ricevuto un nuovo aggiornamento sul samsung s10 +. Possiamo attivare nuovamente la "Collezione OB1"
> 
> Hai controllato questo?

After updating the smartphone, I activated the "OB1" again. Let's see if it works. 
For now it still hasn't restarted :)
Does not work. The phone has just restarted. Turn off "Ob1" again.

I'm getting the same problem with my S10e, which runs as a follower, so there is no way to disable the "OB1 collector" mode.

Really waiting for the fix!!

Samsung appear to have introduced quite a significant bug this time... 
Try this: go in to xDrip settings and disable the `Samsung workarounds`
Hi everyone, today I received a new update from samsung. I installed it, then tried to re-run the "OB1" and "Samsung workarounds" section and it seems to work correctly again ..

@jamorham, I can confirm that disabling "Samsung workarounds" solved the problem for me! Cheers!

Didn't receive fresh update from Samsung yet. I have SM-G9700 (Chinese version)

@olegsegal can I confirm you disabled Samsung Workarounds AND enabled OB1? I get into a reboot loop and have to factory reset, so want to check before I try.  I'm also still waiting for the Samsung update.  Thanks

@Lee-S, as my device works as a follower (not master), I don't have an OB1 option there. I just disabled "Samsung Workaround" and it worked for me.

Factory reset didn't solve the problem, just time waste...

Good Morning, 
What is „Samsung Workarounds“ and where can I find it in the settings?

> Good Morning,
> What is „Samsung Workarounds“ and where can I find it in the settings?

Settings - Less common settings - Other misc options - Samsung Workarounds

> Samsung appear to have introduced quite a significant bug this time...
> Try this: go in to xDrip settings and disable the `Samsung workarounds`

Thanks for suggestion. It works for me.
